description: Mirall config bundle v1 test vectors. Test keys only. Generated by scripts/emit-bundle-vectors.ts. Positives list what the reference verifier returns; `appRefuses` names keys the app's own value check must then drop, `ignoredUnlocked` keys a version 1 app ignores. Every document carries endpoints; `loopbackLever` marks a vector verified with the app's test lever on, which a positive fails as `malformed` without.

positives.name: local stack, behind the test lever only
unlocked entry: verified, ignored by a v1 app
values the app refuses: wrong type, out of range, gate relaxed, malformed relay key
a retention the app refuses: not one of 30, 90 or 365 days
backup folders, resolved on each device
a backup folder the app refuses: no {install}

negatives.name: ciphertext swapped under a valid signature
signed hash does not match the content
apiUrl on localhost, even behind the test lever
loopback apiUrl with a trailing slash, behind the test lever
